column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   base  <ref>  <sha>  <engine version there>
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
#   an assertion the manifest lists that the base run never reached counts as failed, by its shortfall
# A base of - means no complete red run was made: none was possible, the
# suite stopped before reached or reached no assertion, or tests/red itself
# was stopped; its stdout said which unless it was the one stopped.
# Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
base
run
DW1: a fresh hold (LEASE and SINCE now) is in force: felix gate waits
DW1: in force, felix gate waits: FELIX_HOLD_PASSED set but empty does not skip it
DW1: in force, felix gate waits: SINCE 150 s ago under FELIX_DEPLOY_HOLD_LIMIT=200
DW1: in force, felix gate waits: a FELIX_DEPLOY_HOLD_LIMIT of 0 is read as 3600
DW1: in force, felix gate waits: a LEASE 30 s in the future (within now + 60)
DW1: in force, felix gate waits: one project's file garbled and another's in force (lease 1100 s old): any one in force holds the machine
DW2.1: a fresh lease of main's version keeps SINCE and moves LEASE to now
DW2.1: a hold for another version does not keep SINCE: SINCE now, VERSION main's
DW2.1: a stale lease (1300 s) does not keep SINCE: SINCE is now
DW2.1: past the limit the tick keeps refreshing LEASE with SINCE unchanged
DW2.1: the tick asserts the hold: one line of three fields, LEASE now, SINCE = LEASE, VERSION main's
DW2.3: a deploy that ends unverified clears the hold
DW2.3: a hold in force is cleared by the deployed row
DW2.3: after felix land --pause, the tick clears the hold
DW2.3: the tick pausing (the home off main) clears the hold
DW2.3: with no deploy owed the tick clears a hold in force
DW2.4: and the row says the hold has lapsed
DW2.4: its detail holds new suites and gates wait
DW2: the file is written whole, a new file renamed over the old (its inode changes)
DW3: matched does not name a waiter or an ancestor of one
DW3: the tick reads the table once with ps -axo pid=,ppid=,command=
DW3: when every pid pgrep lists is a waiter or an ancestor of one, nothing runs and the tick deploys
DW4 rev 2: and its part runs, with FELIX_HOLD_PASSED=1 in its environment
DW4: a door that goes on exports FELIX_HOLD_PASSED=1 to the project's gate
DW4: a full tests/run under a hold waits: its waiting line, no mktemp made, nothing on stdout
DW4: felix gate with arguments (--quick) waits too
DW4: tests/run --record-assertions waits, before it makes anything
DW4: tests/run --reuse waits, before it makes anything
DW4: tests/run -j 2 waits, before it makes anything
DW4: the tick's own felix gate --quick runs with FELIX_HOLD_PASSED=1
DW4: then its gate runs, with FELIX_HOLD_PASSED=1 exported
DW4: while it waits, felix gate's stdout is empty
DW4: while it waits, the project's gate has not run
DW5: a file still there but no longer in force (a stale lease) ends the wait as the hold lapsed
DW5: and the waiting line says at most 2 s
DW5: bounded: with FELIX_DEPLOY_HOLD_LIMIT=2 and the hold still in force, it goes ahead saying the limit was reached
DW5: once the file is gone it goes ahead within a few polls, saying went ahead after N s: the hold ended
DW5: the first stderr line begins felix gate: waiting for the engine deploy
DW5: the waiting line holds at most <LIMIT> s, 3600 by default
DW5: the waiting line holds the hold's VERSION
DW5: the waiting line names FELIX_DEPLOY_HOLD=off as the way past
DW5: with FELIX_DEPLOY_HOLD_SAY=1 it says a still-waiting line holding the seconds waited
DW6: a waiting felix gate has exactly one marker child, felix-deploy-hold-wait <its memory root> <its poll>
DW6: a waiting tests/run keeps its command line (it matches the tick's pattern) and has one marker child for its root and poll
and landed on the shared home's cache, which this block does not read
and the refresh the hook forked asked the claude for the catalogue
end to end: a new full suite does not run: its waiting line on stderr, no mktemp, nothing on stdout
end to end: and drops the waiter's wrapper, still there and an ancestor of a waiter
end to end: and its suite runs, FELIX_HOLD_PASSED=1 inherited by its part
end to end: and the hold is asserted, in force by DW1 (LEASE now, VERSION main's)
end to end: it refreshes LEASE and keeps SINCE
end to end: the waiter goes ahead, saying went ahead after N s: the hold ended
end to end: the waiter says it is still waiting
end to end: the waiting door keeps its command line and has one marker child for the tick's root
